user.title: Detection

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: Several choices are possible: pick the ones to use. Forecast.Solar creates one entry per panel orientation: tick them all.

data.battery_device_id: Battery or battery Group to drive
data.solar_entry_ids: Solar forecasts to add up (one per panel array)

data.reserve_soc: Reserve when charging is not profitable

data_description.gain_threshold: The battery only charges off-peak if each kWh given back earns at least this amount (0.02 by default).
data_description.efficiency: 85 % by default, then learned over 30 days from the battery counters.
data_description.reserve_soc: Min SOC applied to the batteries when the night is not profitable (50 % by default). Your own settings come back as soon as it is profitable or control is turned off.

loads.title: Large loads
loads.description: Water heater, heat pump, electric vehicle… They are never switched off: they are used to keep the charging power under the subscribed power and to warn you. Optional.

data_description.power_kw: Rated power in kW, for example 3 for a 3,000 W water heater.
data_description.power_sensor: Optional: tells whether it is running.

measure.title: Power measurement
measure.description: Optional: a sensor measuring the power drawn at the main panel (for example Shelly Pro 3EM, battery phase). It feeds the card gauge.

recap.title: Summary

data_description.auto_start: Leave ticked so the conductor drives the battery from tonight. Otherwise it computes the plan without driving anything.

error.no_solar_selected: Select at least one solar forecast.

abort.missing_battery: First install and set up ha-zendure-solarflow-local: {battery_url}
abort.missing_solar: Install a solar forecast first (Forecast.Solar, Open-Meteo Solar Forecast or Solcast): {solar_url}

data.reserve_soc: Reserve when charging is not profitable

data_description.efficiency: 85 % by default, then learned over 30 days from the battery energy counters.
data_description.wear: Battery price ÷ (capacity × announced cycles). 0 to ignore.
data_description.gain_threshold: A night grid charge only happens if each kWh returned earns at least this much (0.02 by default).
data_description.profile: Safety margin added to the peak-hour need: cautious 20 %, balanced 10 %, economical 0 %.
data_description.reserve_soc: Min SOC applied when the night is not profitable (50 % by default).

data.subscribed_kva: Subscribed power (only if missing from Electricity Tariffs)

data_description.subscribed_kva: Read from ha-tarifs-electricite when it is set there.
data_description.three_phase: The limit becomes subscribed power ÷ 3 on the battery's phase; the grid sensor must measure that phase.
data_description.margin: 10 % minimum: the regulation can exceed the limit for 2 to 5 s when a large appliance starts.
data_description.power_sensor: Power drawn sensor (e.g. Shelly Pro 3EM). Feeds the card gauge.
data_description.gauge_warn: As % of the subscribed power (80 % by default).
data_description.gauge_crit: As % of the subscribed power (95 % by default).

consumption.title: House consumption
consumption.description: Without a house sensor, consumption is computed as grid import − export + solar production + battery discharge − battery charge. The daily average is only used until 7 days of history are learned.

data.grid_import_sensor: Grid import energy (if no house sensor)

data_description.house_energy_sensor: Only if it measures the house alone. Leave empty with AC batteries (Zendure AC, AC+): their charge and discharge would be counted as consumption.
data_description.grid_import_sensor: Cumulative energy imported from the grid (e.g. Enphase "Lifetime net energy consumption").
data_description.grid_export_sensor: Cumulative energy exported to the grid (e.g. Enphase "Lifetime net energy production").
data_description.solar_actual_sensor: Cumulative solar production (e.g. Enphase "Production CT energy delivered"). Also used to correct the forecast.
data_description.daily_kwh: Used until 7 days of history are learned.

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: Requires ha-tarifs-electricite ≥ {tariff_min} and ha-zendure-solarflow-local ≥ {battery_min}. Forecast.Solar creates one entry per panel orientation: tick them all.

data.battery_device_id: Battery or battery Group to drive
data.solar_entry_ids: Solar forecasts to add up (one per panel array)

data.tempo_assumption: Assumed Tempo colour while tomorrow's is unknown
data.finish_advance: Finish charging before the end of off-peak hours by

data_description.solar_correction: Needs the actual solar production sensor (Consumption).

loads.title: Large appliances
loads.description: Water heater, heat pump, EV… They are never switched; they are used to plan the charging power and to warn you.

error.no_solar_selected: Select at least one solar forecast.
error.gauge_order: The critical threshold must be higher than the warning threshold.

state.charge_needed: Charge needed to cover tomorrow's peak hours
state.enough_energy: The battery already holds enough energy
state.solar_covers: The sun will cover the need
state.gain_too_low: Price gap too small to be worth the losses
state.capacity_short: Battery too small: energy kept for the most expensive hours

integration_version.title: {name} too old or missing
integration_version.description: The Energy conductor needs {name} {minimum} or newer (found: {found}). Control is suspended until it is updated.

missing_entities.title: Required entities not found
missing_entities.description: These entities could not be found: {keys}. Check that they are enabled, or choose the sources again in the options. Control is suspended.

subscribed_power_missing.title: Subscribed power not set
subscribed_power_missing.description: Set it in Tarifs Électricité (Configure) or in the Power options of the Energy conductor. Without it, no charging can be planned safely.

no_solar_forecast.title: No solar forecast for 24 h
no_solar_forecast.description: None of the selected solar forecasts answered for 24 hours. Plans are computed without sun.

member_battery.title: The selected battery belongs to a Group
member_battery.description: Select the Group instead of the battery in the Sources options: a member battery is driven by its Group.

battery_degraded.title: Battery Group degraded
battery_degraded.description: At least one battery of the Group is out of the distribution. Plans continue with the others.

reserve_unavailable.title: SOC reserve cannot be applied
reserve_unavailable.description: The conductor cannot find the min SOC and max SOC settings of the batteries. Update ha-zendure-solarflow-local: without them, the 50 % reserve and the switch to 100 % on sunny days are disabled; the rest of the control works.

notify_plan_charge.message: Tonight: charging {energy} up to {soc} %, starting {start}. Estimated gain {gain}.

notify_plan_idle.message: Tonight: no charging, the battery has enough energy.

notify_plan_not_profitable.message: Tonight: no charging, the price gap does not cover the battery losses.

notify_power_alert.message: Risk of exceeding the subscribed power tonight (limit {limit}): check the large appliances.

notify_charge_unfinished.message: Tonight's charge stopped at {soc} % instead of {target} %.

force_night.name: Force tonight
force_night.description: Imposes a charge or a rest for the current night; automatic control resumes the next day.

target_soc.name: Target state of charge
target_soc.description: For a charge; maximum SOC if empty.
